title: Nervous system: female anatomy
description: The female figure with every nerve pathway highlighted — study pelvic plexus branching on female proportions.

questions.question: Is the female nervous system different from the male nervous system?
questions.answer: The central and most peripheral pathways follow the same basic plan. Pelvic branches follow different organ relationships around the uterus, vagina and external genital region.

questions.question: What nerves supply the female pelvis?
questions.answer: Pelvic autonomic plexuses reach pelvic organs; pudendal branches contribute somatic sensation and motor supply in the perineum. These are distinct from the wider limb plexuses.

questions.question: What does the brain do in the female nervous system?
questions.answer: Cerebrum, cerebellum and brainstem inside the cranial vault. Function: Integration, consciousness, motor planning and autonomic control.

questions.question: Where is the cervical plexus on the female nerve map?
questions.answer: Nerve network in the posterior triangle of the neck. Function: Neck muscles and skin; phrenic nerve to diaphragm.

questions.question: What do the intercostal nerves do in the female body?
questions.answer: Function: Chest-wall muscles and segmental skin band. Ventral rami running in subcostal grooves.
